name: Harod
line: Harod was a spring where Gideon's army camped before facing Midian, and where God likely cut his large army down to just three hundred men.

moments.title: Gideon camps at the spring
moments.text: Gideon and all his men camped beside the spring of Harod. The camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.

moments.title: God chooses men at the water
moments.text: God said Gideon had too many men, so He had them tested at the water by how they drank. Only three hundred lapped with their hands, and God said He would save Israel through them.
